info.name: Find optimal route between tokens (direct routes, zaps)

params.name: chainId
params.description: Chain ID of the network to execute the transaction on

params.name: fromAddress
params.description: Ethereum address of the wallet to send the transaction from

params.name: routingStrategy
params.description: Routing strategy to use

params.name: executionMode
params.description: Controls how quote is built based on execution mode

params.name: toEoa
params.description: Flag that indicates if gained tokenOut should be sent to EOA

params.name: receiver
params.description: Ethereum address of the receiver of the tokenOut

params.name: spender
params.description: Ethereum address of the spender of the tokenIn

params.name: refundReceiver
params.description: Ethereum address of the receiver of any dust tokens that might be produced during the execution of actions

params.name: amountIn
params.description: Amount of tokenIn to swap in wei

params.name: minAmountOut
params.description: Minimum amount out in wei. If specified, slippage should not be specified

params.name: slippage
params.description: Slippage in basis points (1/10000). e.g. 50 = 0.50%. If specified, minAmountOut should not be specified

params.name: fee
params.description: Fee in basis points (1/10000) for each amountIn value. Must be in range 0-100. If specified, this percentage of each amountIn value will be sent to feeReceiver

params.name: feeReceiver
params.description: The Ethereum address that will receive the collected fee. Required if fee is provided

params.name: ignoreAggregators
params.description: A list of swap aggregators to be ignored from consideration

params.name: ignoreStandards
params.description: A list of standards to be ignored from consideration

params.name: ignoreBridges
params.description: A list of bridges to be ignored from consideration (e.g. stargate, ccip, relay)

params.name: referralCode
params.description: Referral code that will be included in an on-chain event.

params.name: tokenIn
params.description: Ethereum address of the token to swap from. For ETH, use 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

params.name: tokenOut
params.description: Ethereum address of the token to swap to. For ETH, use 0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee

params.name: destinationChainId
params.description: Chain ID of the network to bridge to and receive tokenOut
